note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: upstream/glm53-flash at 0b515eec (upstream/glm53-flash-20261012-rc4: the RC4 engine commits on a1c9b1bc plus four CI-only fixes, none changing GB10 runtime behavior) plus the GLM tool-value fix: the envelope-stuck guard (MAX_TOOL_BODY_TOKENS = 1024) recognized parameter values only by Qwen's <parameter=...> token ids, so it cut any GLM tool call longer than about 1024 tokens (finish_reason length, no tool call); GLM's single-token <arg_value>/</arg_value> are now resolved at startup and value bodies tracked by them.

sparkglm_only.note: The seven SparkGLM-only commits re-layered on the upstream candidate: FlashKDA/native sparse-MLA prefill bridges (the first, 661a26a0, now declares the KV-shard flag its native bridge reads, which upstream dropped as unused), GB10 display-carveout KV placement (latent pools only, ATLAS_KV_CARVEOUT_ORDER), and sharded latent pools (ATLAS_GLM_KV_SHARD, opt-in through SPARKGLM_KV_SHARD) sized and placed in the carveout. Fork-only; the carveout is used only with DISPLAY_CARVEOUT=1.

integration.note: RC4 (tree ae5e79f8, the measured exp/prose-rc4 c6089633). This pin differs from it by the tool-value fix (spark-server only) and the four CI-only upstream commits; the decode path is unchanged.
